steps.description: Retrieve the latest version of the application source code from the version control repository.
Initiate an automated build and testing process based on the updated source code.
Package the application into a deployable artifact suitable for the target environment.
Store the built artifact in a centralized repository for versioned access and distribution.
Release the new application version to the target runtime environment and update the running service.
Verify the deployment's success by checking application logs and performance metrics.
Update the deployment records and documentation to reflect the new version and changes.
Notify stakeholders about the successful deployment and any notable changes or features.
Collect performance and operational metrics from application components and infrastructure resources.
Aggregate and display collected metrics through dashboards for real-time visibility.
Define threshold-based conditions to detect abnormal system behavior.
Notify responsible teams when alert conditions are triggered.
Examine system logs and metrics to identify the root cause of detected issues.
Apply temporary fixes or mitigations to stabilize the system until a permanent solution is found.
Collaborate with development teams to implement long-term fixes and improvements.
Document the incident, including root cause, resolution, and lessons learned for future reference.
Provision and configure new infrastructure resources as needed.
Monitor resource utilization and adjust capacity to meet changing demand.
Implement security measures such as firewalls, access controls, and encryption.
Perform routine maintenance tasks such as backups, updates, and patching.
Optimize resource allocation and utilization to minimize costs and improve efficiency.
Ensure compliance with organizational policies and regulatory requirements.
Document infrastructure configurations, changes, and updates for auditing and troubleshooting purposes.
Collaborate with other teams to ensure seamless integration and operation of infrastructure resources.

steps.description: Design and implement automated testing frameworks for application code.

Collaborate with development teams to ensure seamless integration of CI/CD pipelines with development workflows.
Document CI/CD pipeline configurations, changes, and updates for auditing and troubleshooting purposes.
Continuously evaluate and improve CI/CD pipelines to optimize efficiency, reliability, and quality.

parsed.step_description: Retrieve the latest version of the application source code from the version control repository.
parsed.current_solution: Git CLI or IDE integration, such as GitHub Desktop or Git Kraken, to fetch the latest code

parsed.step_description: Initiate an automated build and testing process based on the updated source code.
parsed.current_solution: Jenkins or Travis CI to automate build and testing, triggered by Git webhook

parsed.step_description: Package the application into a deployable artifact suitable for the target environment.
parsed.current_solution: Maven or Gradle for Java-based projects, or npm and yarn for JavaScript-based projects, to create deployable artifacts

parsed.step_description: Store the built artifact in a centralized repository for versioned access and distribution.
parsed.current_solution: Artifactory or Nexus as a centralized repository manager for storing and managing artifacts

parsed.step_description: Release the new application version to the target runtime environment and update the running service.
parsed.current_solution: Kubernetes or Docker Swarm for container orchestration, and Ansible or Puppet for configuration management

parsed.step_description: Verify the deployment's success by checking application logs and performance metrics.
parsed.current_solution: ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) for log analysis, and Prometheus and Grafana for performance monitoring

parsed.step_description: Update the deployment records and documentation to reflect the new version and changes.
parsed.current_solution: Confluence or Wiki for documentation management, and Jira or Trello for issue tracking and deployment management

parsed.step_description: Notify stakeholders about the successful deployment and any notable changes or features.
parsed.current_solution: Email notifications using Mailchimp or Sendgrid, or collaboration tools like Slack or Microsoft Teams

parsed.step_description: Collect performance and operational metrics from application components and infrastructure resources.
parsed.current_solution: Prometheus and Grafana for metrics collection and visualization, and New Relic or Datadog for application performance monitoring

parsed.step_description: Aggregate and display collected metrics through dashboards for real-time visibility.
parsed.current_solution: Grafana or Tableau for data visualization, and Kibana for log analysis and visualization

parsed.step_description: Define threshold-based conditions to detect abnormal system behavior.
parsed.current_solution: Prometheus Alertmanager for threshold-based alerting, and PagerDuty or VictorOps for incident management

parsed.step_description: Notify responsible teams when alert conditions are triggered.
parsed.current_solution: PagerDuty or VictorOps for incident management, and Slack or Microsoft Teams for team notifications

parsed.step_description: Examine system logs and metrics to identify the root cause of detected issues.
parsed.current_solution: ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) for log analysis, and Splunk or Sumo Logic for log management

parsed.step_description: Apply temporary fixes or mitigations to stabilize the system until a permanent solution is found.
parsed.current_solution: Ansible or Puppet for configuration management, and Kubernetes or Docker Swarm for container orchestration

parsed.step_description: Collaborate with development teams to implement long-term fixes and improvements.
parsed.current_solution: Jira or Trello for issue tracking, and GitHub or GitLab for version control and collaboration

parsed.step_description: Document the incident, including root cause, resolution, and lessons learned for future reference.
parsed.current_solution: Confluence or Wiki for documentation management, and Jira or Trello for issue tracking and incident management

parsed.step_description: Monitor resource utilization and adjust capacity to meet changing demand.

parsed.step_description: Implement security measures such as firewalls, access controls, and encryption.
